requirement_vague: Item creation should reject description with exact 256 characters.
requirement_precise: Register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test55@example.com' and password 'validpass123'. Login to get token. Attempt to create item via POST /api/v1/items/ with title 'Valid Title' and description of exactly 256 characters (256 'a' characters). Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.reasoning: The item creation endpoint uses the ItemCreate Pydantic model, whose description validator rejects any description longer than 255 characters. A description of exactly 256 characters therefore fails request validation, and FastAPI returns a 422 validation error before create_item executes.
